records.evidence_summary: 2017 human retinitis pigmentosa candidate with zebrafish rescue predates cutoff; 2025 twelve-family syndromic series is maturation/expansion, not first-target novelty.

Original 2016 fulltext PMC5001803 describes macular degeneration and hearing loss in patient1 and pigmentary retinopathy in three siblings of a separate Belgian family. Later retina reports cannot enter first-target recovery.

2022 two retinal families; independent 2024 report DOI10.1016/j.gimo.2024.101834 online2024-02-29 adds four families, three without the alternative homozygous SPATA7 diagnosis. Supporting 2026 Portuguese family not required. Multigene replication abstract omits symbol and was missed by gene-title/abstract search; catalog/fulltext review is essential.

2023 Chinese dominant RP pedigree with variant reduction, zebrafish perturbation and mitophagy assays; independent Mexican RP family2025. Prior2021 neurodevelopmental association is non-target and must be separately cited.

Clinical PMC12679428: three patients/two unrelated families with segregating homozygous truncating alleles. Earlier Egflam knockout studies produce cCSNB-like ERG defects. New article localization alone is not used as functional proof. January2026 issue is later than electronic publication.

Clinical PMC13087473: six subjects/five families with six biallelic predicted-null variants. Earlier spontaneous Mdm1 nonsense and engineered knockout mice show retinal degeneration. Human healthy localization/protein interaction alone is not functional proof.

Original Bonora2021 Table1: macular degeneration in patients1-1/1-2/2-1/2-2 establishes two unrelated retinal families; patient3-2 also has hearing loss. Patient-cell ligase/mtDNA functional defects and zebrafish phenotype. Received/accepted2020 are not public dates.

Original human RTH series1996 reports hearing loss;2012 PMC3319181 lists hearing loss in multiple THRB-genotyped families. Postcutoff macular dystrophy is target phenotype expansion. 2011 mouse-only study is not the human prior.

Two unrelated dominant hearing-loss families with different frameshift variants, segregation, reporter activity loss and earlier knockout hearing phenotype. Prior2018 cardiovascular/skeletal/immune/corectopia and superior-coloboma reports concern non-target phenotypes under explicit scope.
Human retinal dystrophy and independent retinal series predating cutoff; later pathology cannot be counted as novel-target association.

Real recessive retinal findings predate cutoff in Nasca2017 and Iwama2018 (DOI10.1038/s10038-017-0405-8), reproduced in PMC6913144 Table1. Separate disputed dominant allele actually belongs to MSTO2P pseudogene and is not used as the prior evidence.
Initial2013 human leukodystrophy abstract explicitly includes chorioretinopathy/optic neuropathy;2023 retinal report is expansion, not first-target novelty.
